title: Convenient Crafts
description: This adds new recipes into the game for more convenience.
body:
Craftables is a datapack made to allow items with no recipe or inconvient recipes to have simpler recipes. 

Recipes are found below, aswell as verisons:
Orignal version of the datapack.
Includes:
- God Apple(Golden apple surrounded by gold blocks)
- Bottle o'Enchanting(Shapeless; bottle, lapis and redstone)
- Totem of Undying(Enchanted golden apple, diamond blocks in corners, and emerald blocks in bewtween diamond blocks)
- Dragons Breath(Eye of ender, bottle, blaze powder)
- Wither Star(netherite ingots in corners, with wither-skeleton skull inbetween them, totem in the middle)

Pictures of recipes can be found in the gallery. If you have recipe suggestions, join my Discord server!
